summary: Love and values press against discipline and limits. This frictional pattern asks you to use relational grace and maturity with awareness.
body: Love and values press against discipline and limits. This frictional pattern asks you to use relational grace and maturity with awareness. Difficulty enjoying success, fear of loss, blocked rewards, and free-floating guilt. The friction makes the pattern noticeable, especially when pressure forces an adjustment. In practice, this can show up through love and values, discipline and limits, and the choices you make when approval seeking or fear starts running the room.
gift: The gift is relational grace, maturity, and a more conscious way to work with love and values and discipline and limits.
shadow: The shadow is approval seeking, fear, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let love and values and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
do: Name how love and values and discipline and limits are both involved
Pause before choosing the most familiar reaction
Turn relational grace and maturity into one concrete choice
dont: Let approval seeking make the decision
Treat tension as proof that something is wrong
Ignore the needs of love and values or discipline and limits
